description: GEOGLAM-BACS gives best available crop specific masks for wheat, maize, rice and soybean over the major producing and exporting countries, made for the G20 Global Agricultural Monitoring initiative. The Zenodo record says the covered countries account for 84 percent of soy, 54 percent of maize, 62 percent of wheat and 92 percent of rice production globally, and that the masks underpin satellite crop condition monitoring and are used operationally in the GEOGLAM Crop Monitor reports. It was published in October 2022 (version 1.0.0) by a team led from the University of Maryland Department of Geographical Sciences with the GEOGLAM Secretariat and other institutions, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 7 MB. Coverage is the main producing countries. Caveats: the record notes that validation, extent, resolution and seasonal specificity need improvement, and the resolution is not stated in the part read. For simulation it gives crop-specific area masks to weight drought, heat and flood hazards by crop for food supply monitoring. Related catalogue records include the GEOGLAM Crop Monitor and the JRC MARS AGRI4CAST data.
